public.title: Public access
public.text: This section is open to everyone. The page is loading.

private.title: Access closed
private.text: The administrator has temporarily closed public access to this section.

code.title: Access code required
code.text: Enter the code sent by the administrator. One activation creates a session, so a normal page refresh does not consume the code again.

link.title: Private link required
link.text: Open the link provided by an administrator. If it was revoked or expired, request a new one.

errors.CONTENT_TOKEN_INVALID: The code or private link is invalid.
errors.CONTENT_TOKEN_EXHAUSTED: This code or link has already reached its maximum number of uses.
errors.NO_CURRENT_PERIOD: There is no active cycle to issue private access for.
errors.default: Access could not be checked. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.CONTENT_CODE_RATE_LIMITED: Too many invalid codes. Try again in one hour.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.

cycleClosed.title: Wasteland cycle finished
cycleClosed.players: The player list for this cycle is closed. The next registration opens on Friday.
cycleClosed.finalPlan: The final plan for this cycle is closed. A new plan will be available in the next cycle through a new private link.

cycleUnavailable: Unable to verify the access schedule. Please try again later.

cycleUpdating.title: Waiting for updated cycle data
cycleUpdating.text: The new cycle has already started, but public data is still being updated. Please try again shortly.
cycleUpdating.players: The player table for the new cycle is still being updated. Please try again shortly.
cycleUpdating.final_plan: The final plan for the new cycle is still being updated. Please try again shortly.
